ESUG 2027 App — Privacy Policy

The ESUG 2027 conference companion app does not collect, store, transmit, or share any personal information. The app works entirely offline, displaying static conference information (venue, city, travel, program, and registration details) that is bundled with the app itself. It does not use analytics, tracking, or third-party services, and does not require you to create an account or provide any personal data. If you have questions about this policy, contact koen@all-objects-all-the-time.st.
